boundary_notice.zh: 临时粗略边界 / 低置信 / 非官方；所有落位、面积与比例须在官方 polygon 到位后整体复算。
boundary_notice.en: Provisional rough boundary / low confidence / non-official; recompute all locations, areas, and ratios when official polygons arrive.

brand.promise_zh: 拒绝可选生物识别，也不失去同一扇回家门。
brand.promise_en: Decline optional biometrics without losing the same way home.
brand.mark_description_zh: 圆角门框被一条可撤的金色门槛分为上下两把钥匙：深蓝实体/非生物路径始终在场，蓝色智能路径只能并列、不能封门。珊瑚色点表示具名人工复核。
brand.mark_description_en: A rounded threshold is divided by a removable gold bar into two keys: the navy physical/non-biometric path remains available, while the blue smart path may sit beside it but never seal the door. The coral point marks named human review.

rules.zh: 深蓝表示普通通行，蓝色表示可选智能层，金色表示可撤门槛，珊瑚色只用于人工 HOLD/RETURN。
rules.en: Navy means ordinary entry; blue means optional smart layer; gold means a removable threshold; coral is reserved for human HOLD/RETURN.

rules.zh: 标志不得出现人脸、眼睛、指纹、摄像头或房屋权属暗示。
rules.en: The mark must not contain faces, eyes, fingerprints, cameras, or claims of housing title.

rules.zh: 任何应用都先显示普通钥匙，再显示可选智能钥匙；不得让智能路径尺寸更大。
rules.en: Every application shows the ordinary key first and the optional smart key second; the smart path may not be visually larger.

functional_difference.public_problem: Housing access may become coercive when a landlord, property operator, or vendor turns face, voice, gait, phone, or behavioural data into the factual residential threshold.
functional_difference.beneficiaries: Residents whose housing relationship is confirmed through an applicable human procedure, including tenants, owners, co-residents, minors, caregivers, people without smartphones, and people who decline sensitive-data processing.
functional_difference.complete_task: Separate housing-status review from biometric participation; issue an equivalent non-biometric credential; keep daily and emergency entry available; prohibit refusal from automatically flowing into rent, deposit, renewal, repairs, parcel pickup, basic property service, or eviction decisions; resolve disputes through named humans; update or revoke all credentials through the same authorised procedure.
functional_difference.spatial_carrier: A 1:1 synthetic paired-threshold prototype with an ordinary non-biometric lane, optional smart lane, camera-free review room, mechanical disconnect, night call point, and private signage.
functional_difference.human_right_and_decision: A resident may decline optional biometrics without losing equivalent residential entry or basic property service; a building access operations owner and an independent housing/tenancy rights reviewer make the named decisions.
functional_difference.failure_result: Stop the biometric/predictive layer, restore physical key, non-biometric card, or staffed entry, and leave any housing dispute to the applicable human/professional process instead of terminating entry from pilot records.
functional_difference.closest_boundary: Generic minimum-auth public entry and smart residential gates exist in the merged catalog, but the catalog search at main@dd405743 did not find this complete housing-power chain.

positions.zh: 百年京张文化带：把铁路备用钥匙与人工值守转译为‘技术层可撤、回家路不断’。
positions.en: Centennial Jing-Zhang Cultural Belt: translate railway redundancy and staffed operation into ‘the technology layer can leave; the way home remains’.

positions.zh: 都市 AI 生活体验带：让拒绝敏感识别后的等价日常通行成为可见、可测的城市生活底线。
positions.en: Metropolitan AI Life Experience Belt: make equivalent daily entry after declining sensitive recognition a visible, testable urban-life baseline.

positions.zh: AI 融合创新带：把非生物凭证、机械断开、反报复数据隔离和供应商退出变成产业验证任务。
positions.en: AI Fusion Innovation Belt: turn non-biometric credentials, mechanical disconnect, anti-retaliation data isolation, and vendor exit into industry validation tasks.

functions.zh: AI 全栈自主创新体系
functions.move_zh: 本地凭证、最小事件日志、机械断开与人工值守构成可移植接口。
functions.move_en: Portable interfaces combine local credentials, minimal event logs, mechanical disconnect, and staffed operation.

functions.zh: 世界级 AI 创新生态
functions.move_zh: 隐私工程、物业运营、住房程序、消防安防、无障碍与一线劳动共同验证。
functions.move_en: Privacy engineering, property operations, housing procedure, fire/security, accessibility, and frontline labour validate together.

functions.move_zh: 三类住宅门槛测试、十张任务卡和六类画像都以等价通行为结果。
functions.move_en: Three residential-threshold tests, ten task cards, and six personas use equivalent entry as the outcome.

functions.zh: 智能化 AI 活力城市
functions.move_zh: 普通钥匙先于智能钥匙；拒绝状态不成为租住或物业处置标签。
functions.move_en: The ordinary key precedes the smart key; refusal never becomes a tenancy or property-service label.

functions.move_zh: 公开失败类型、恢复时间和可撤组件，不公开住户名单或门禁轨迹。
functions.move_en: Publish failure types, restoration time, and revocable components—not resident lists or access trails.

areas_wings.zh: 众智园：凭证与设备互操作、断网和供应商退出压力测试。
areas_wings.en: Zhongzhiyuan: credential/device interoperability, outage, and vendor-exit stress tests.

areas_wings.zh: AI 原点社区：居住者、物业一线、残障与隐私代表共创 1:1 双路径门厅。
areas_wings.en: AI Origin Community: residents, frontline property staff, disability and privacy representatives co-design a 1:1 paired-path lobby.

areas_wings.zh: 大钟寺：夜间、访客、包裹、维修与运营换手的普通服务连续演练。
areas_wings.en: Dazhongsi: rehearse ordinary-service continuity for night entry, visitors, parcels, repairs, and operator handover.

areas_wings.zh: 中关村科技服务翼：发布接口规范、权利台账、采购退出条款和专业复核清单。
areas_wings.en: Zhongguancun Technology Service Wing: publish interface specifications, rights ledgers, procurement-exit clauses, and professional checklists.

areas_wings.zh: 小月河场景赋能翼：只做非识别慢行到达、夜间照明与无障碍门槛体验，不采集精确居住轨迹。
areas_wings.en: Xiaoyuehe Scenario Empowerment Wing: test non-identifying arrival, night lighting, and accessible thresholds without collecting precise residential trajectories.

case_lenses.transfer_zh: 目的明确、直接相关、影响最小、最短必要保存和自动化决定权利机制约束数据链；不创造住宅资格。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Purpose limitation, direct relevance, minimum impact, shortest necessary retention, and automated-decision rights constrain the data chain; they do not create housing status.

case_lenses.zh: 《人脸识别技术应用安全管理办法》
case_lenses.en: Measures for the Security Management of Facial Recognition Technology Applications
case_lenses.publisher: CAC and Ministry of Public Security
case_lenses.transfer_zh: 同等目的可用非人脸方式时保留合理便利替代；适用性仍需逐事项专业判断。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Where the same purpose can be achieved without face recognition, retain a reasonable convenient alternative; applicability still requires matter-specific professional review.

case_lenses.zh: 《北京市无障碍环境建设条例》
case_lenses.publisher: Beijing Municipal People’s Congress Standing Committee
case_lenses.transfer_zh: 智慧创新与传统服务并行、使用者试用和信息可及支持原型验收；不证明具体楼栋条件。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Parallel smart/traditional service, user trials, and accessible information inform prototype acceptance; they do not prove a building’s conditions.

case_lenses.zh: NIST SP 800-63-4 数字身份指南
case_lenses.transfer_zh: 先问是否需要现实身份，再选择认证强度；美国技术指南不是中国法律。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Ask whether real-world identity is needed before selecting assurance; US technical guidance is not Chinese law.

case_lenses.transfer_zh: 选择性披露、自愿使用与保留替代路径作为技术比较；欧盟法律不是本地合规依据。
case_lenses.transfer_en: Selective disclosure, voluntary use, and retained alternatives are technical comparison lenses; EU law is not a local compliance basis.

industry_tests.zh: 凭证等价与互操作测试
industry_tests.input_zh: 6 个合成人物在实体钥匙、非生物卡、临时码和可选智能路径之间完成同一门厅任务。
industry_tests.input_en: Six synthetic personas complete the same lobby task using a physical key, non-biometric card, temporary code, and optional smart path.
industry_tests.human_zh: 门禁运营责任人和消防安防专业者确认安全边界；独立住房/租赁权益复核人确认拒绝不影响住房程序。
industry_tests.human_en: The access-operations owner and fire/security professional confirm safety boundaries; an independent housing/tenancy rights reviewer confirms refusal does not affect housing procedure.
industry_tests.fail_zh: 非生物路径明显更慢、更暴露或无法完成同一任务即 RETURN。
industry_tests.fail_en: RETURN if the non-biometric path is materially slower, more exposing, or cannot complete the same task.

industry_tests.input_zh: 合成拒绝状态、门禁故障与租金、押金、续租、维修、包裹和基本物业字段并列。
industry_tests.input_en: Synthetic refusal and access-failure states sit beside rent, deposit, renewal, repair, parcel, and basic-property-service fields.
industry_tests.human_zh: 隐私/档案专业者验证字段隔离；住房/租赁权益复核人检查任何不利处置必须脱离试点记录。
industry_tests.human_en: Privacy/records professionals verify field isolation; the housing/tenancy rights reviewer checks that any adverse action is independent of pilot records.
industry_tests.fail_zh: 拒绝或设备故障流入任一租住/物业处置字段即 STOP。
industry_tests.fail_en: STOP if refusal or equipment failure flows into any tenancy/property disposition field.

industry_tests.zh: 断网、夜间与供应商退出测试
industry_tests.input_zh: 网络中断、手机丢失、卡片丢失、夜间回家、照护者临时到访与供应商停止服务。
industry_tests.input_en: Network outage, lost phone, lost card, night return, temporary caregiver visit, and vendor service termination.
industry_tests.human_zh: 值班人员启动机械开启和夜间呼叫；门禁运营责任人与数据责任人共同签署退出移交。
industry_tests.human_en: Staff activate mechanical opening and night call; access-operations and data owners co-sign vendor-exit handover.
industry_tests.fail_zh: AI/供应商关闭后普通住宅通行无法继续，或无人接手开放清单，即停止智能试点。
industry_tests.fail_en: Stop the smart pilot if ordinary residential entry cannot continue after AI/vendor shutdown or no one accepts the open list.

personas.zh: 拒绝人脸识别的租住者
personas.need_zh: 同一住宅入口的等价凭证与反报复隔离
personas.need_en: Equivalent credential at the same residential entrance and anti-retaliation separation

personas.zh: 无智能手机的老年居住者
personas.need_zh: 实体凭证、人工值守、易读说明与夜间呼叫
personas.need_en: Physical credential, staffed entry, easy-read instructions, and night call

personas.zh: 面部识别困难或行动不便的居住者
personas.en: Resident with facial-recognition difficulty or mobility impairment
personas.need_zh: 无差别可达路径、低位台、坐姿操作与不公开拒绝状态
personas.need_en: Non-stigmatising accessible path, low counter, seated operation, and private refusal status

personas.need_zh: 代理权限人工核验、临时凭证与不建立家庭关系画像
personas.need_en: Human review of authority, temporary credential, and no family-relationship profiling

personas.zh: 共同居住关系有争议的双方
personas.en: People in a disputed co-residence relationship
personas.need_zh: 临时安全通行、争议挂起和独立住房/租赁程序
personas.need_en: Temporary safe entry, dispute hold, and independent housing/tenancy process

personas.zh: 物业一线值班与维修人员
personas.need_zh: 排班上限、替班、明确权限、机械断开与不承担无限备用责任
personas.need_en: Staffing limits, cover shifts, clear authority, mechanical disconnect, and no unlimited fallback burden

scenario_cards.zh: 入住核验与拒绝识别分离
scenario_cards.en: Separate housing review from biometric choice
scenario_cards.decision_zh: 有权住房/租赁程序确认关系；门禁运营责任人只发凭证
scenario_cards.decision_en: Authorised housing/tenancy procedure confirms the relationship; access owner only issues credentials

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 门禁运营责任人按同一规则签发
scenario_cards.decision_en: Access owner issues under the same rule

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 值班人员先安全接待，具名复核人后核权限
scenario_cards.decision_en: Staff provide safe reception first; named reviewer checks authority next
scenario_cards.ai_en: Flag missing items; never decide entry

scenario_cards.carrier_zh: 夜间呼叫与机械开启点
scenario_cards.carrier_en: Night call and mechanical opening point
scenario_cards.decision_zh: 当班人员按应急程序决定
scenario_cards.decision_en: On-duty staff decide under emergency procedure

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 居住者或有权代理确认，不建立家庭画像
scenario_cards.decision_en: Resident or authorised representative confirms; no family profile
scenario_cards.ai_zh: 只生成一次性凭证草稿

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 独立住房/租赁权益复核人处理；物业/供应商不得裁决
scenario_cards.decision_en: Independent housing/tenancy rights reviewer handles it; property operator/vendor cannot adjudicate
scenario_cards.ai_en: Must not infer who is lying

scenario_cards.zh: 维修、包裹与基本物业服务
scenario_cards.en: Repairs, parcels, and basic property service
scenario_cards.decision_zh: 事项责任人按原程序办理
scenario_cards.decision_en: Matter owner follows the ordinary process

scenario_cards.decision_zh: 门禁运营责任人与数据责任人签收

scenario_cards.zh: 居住关系依法或依有效程序变化
scenario_cards.en: Housing relationship changes through applicable procedure
scenario_cards.decision_zh: 有权人工按同一规则更新/撤销各类凭证
scenario_cards.decision_en: Authorised human updates/revokes every credential under the same rule
scenario_cards.ai_zh: 不得宣布关系成立或终止
scenario_cards.ai_en: Must not declare a relationship started or ended

landmarks.purpose_zh: 一把可触摸机械钥匙与一个可撤智能模块并列，先讲普通通行、后讲技术；不接真实门禁。
landmarks.purpose_en: A tactile mechanical key sits beside a removable smart module, explaining ordinary entry before technology; it connects to no real access system.

landmarks.purpose_zh: 两条同目的地路径与私密复核间共同构成 1:1 空载原型，不公开谁拒绝识别。
landmarks.purpose_en: Two paths to the same destination and a private review room form a 1:1 unloaded prototype without revealing who declines recognition.

landmarks.purpose_zh: 只显示 AI/供应商关闭后普通路径恢复时间和开放故障数，不显示住户或轨迹。
landmarks.purpose_en: Shows only ordinary-path restoration time and open fault counts after AI/vendor shutdown, never residents or trails.

operations.zh: 第二把钥匙合成压力测试日
operations.owner_zh: 独立测试主持 + 门禁运营/住房/隐私/无障碍专业者
operations.owner_en: Independent test lead + access, housing, privacy, and accessibility professionals
operations.gate_zh: 只用合成人物与空载门厅；普通服务不受影响
operations.gate_en: Synthetic personas and unloaded lobby only; ordinary service unaffected
operations.exit_zh: 泄露、报复字段或生物识别升级即撤下测试
operations.exit_en: Withdraw test on leakage, retaliation fields, or biometric escalation

operations.owner_zh: 物业一线代表 + 居住者/残障/照护代表 + 消防安防专业者
operations.owner_en: Frontline property staff + resident/disability/caregiver representatives + fire/security professionals
operations.gate_zh: 路径完成、等待、暴露、人工接管、排班容量逐项记录
operations.gate_en: Record completion, waiting, exposure, human takeover, and staffing capacity
operations.exit_zh: 任何群体无等价路径或一线人员成为无限备用即 HOLD
operations.exit_en: HOLD if any group lacks an equivalent path or frontline staff become unlimited fallback

operations.zh: 可撤住宅 AI 门槛公开论坛
operations.owner_zh: 建议的运营团队 + 独立专业评审
operations.owner_en: Proposed operations team + independent professional panel
operations.gate_zh: 只发布协议、合成失败和组件；不发布住户/机构名单
operations.gate_en: Publish protocols, synthetic failures, and components only; no resident/institution lists
operations.exit_zh: 不得写成政府已确定活动、招商或采购安排
operations.exit_en: Never present as a confirmed government event, investment, or procurement programme

operations.zh: 第二把钥匙组件与贡献荣誉架
operations.en: Second Key component and contribution rack
operations.owner_zh: 贡献者自愿授权 + 社区维护者
operations.gate_zh: 仅展示自制规范、组件和合成验证；逐资产权利记录
operations.gate_en: Display authored specifications, components, and synthetic validation only; maintain asset-level rights
operations.exit_zh: 撤回署名后移除识别信息，保留去标识版本事实
operations.exit_en: Remove identifying credit after withdrawal while retaining de-identified version facts

implementation.zh: 权属、住房程序与普通钥匙清点
implementation.en: Inventory title, housing procedure, and ordinary keys
implementation.owner_zh: 建筑/物业责任人 + 独立住房/租赁权益专业者
implementation.owner_en: Building/property owner + independent housing/tenancy rights professional
implementation.evidence_zh: 现有钥匙、卡片、值守、应急开启、消防和有效程序清单
implementation.evidence_en: Existing key, card, staffing, emergency opening, fire, and applicable-procedure inventory

implementation.evidence_zh: 6 画像 × 10 场景完成、等待、暴露和接管记录
implementation.evidence_en: Completion, waiting, exposure, and takeover records for 6 personas × 10 scenarios

implementation.zh: 专业和受影响者共同审查
implementation.owner_zh: 住房/物业/消防/安防/隐私/档案/无障碍/劳动专业者与居住者代表
implementation.owner_en: Housing, property, fire, security, privacy, records, accessibility, labour professionals and resident representatives
implementation.evidence_zh: 逐项签署清单、排班容量、反报复隔离与退出演练
implementation.evidence_en: Itemised signed checklist, staffing capacity, anti-retaliation separation, and exit rehearsal

implementation.zh: 有限、非真实住宅公共演示
implementation.owner_zh: 场地与公共服务责任人
implementation.evidence_zh: 空载演示回执、无真实住户/租约/生物数据证明
implementation.evidence_en: Unloaded demonstration receipt and proof of no real residents, leases, or biometric data

implementation.zh: 退出、拆除与普通通行恢复
implementation.owner_zh: 门禁运营责任人与数据责任人
implementation.evidence_zh: 模块拆除、日志处置依据、开放清单与普通钥匙恢复
implementation.evidence_en: Module removal, log-disposition basis, open list, and ordinary-key restoration
